# Balanced Mind of NY

> A mental health resource specializing in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) approaches for trauma, PTSD, and attachment-related psychological wounds.

Balanced Mind of NY provides evidence-based therapeutic content focused on CBT techniques for treating complex trauma, relational wounds, and shame-based patterns. The site offers specialized guidance on healing from childhood attachment issues and trauma-related psychological conditions.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Complex PTSD (CPTSD)
- Attachment Wounds
- Relational Trauma
- Shame Healing
- Inner Critic
- Trauma Therapy
- Core Shame
- CBT Techniques
- Trauma-Based Patterns
- Childhood Wounds
- Complex PTSD Treatment

## CBT for Trauma & PTSD

- [CBT for Attachment Wounds: Healing Relational Trauma](https://balancedmindofny.com/blog/cbt-for-attachment-wounds): CBT approach to healing attachment wounds and relational trauma from childhood
- [CBT for Shame in Complex PTSD: Healing Core Shame](https://balancedmindofny.com/blog/cbt-for-shame): Specialized CBT techniques for trauma-based shame and inner critic in CPTSD
